name: How long does it typically take to complete a room addition?

mainEntity.name: How long does it typically take to complete a room addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a room addition generally ranges from three to six months once construction begins, depending on size and site complexity. The overall process includes initial design, city plan reviews and building permits, foundation excavation and pouring, framing, utility rough-ins for electrical and plumbing, drywall, and final trim carpentry. If your project involves complex connections, such as adding a primary suite with a custom bathroom or building a second story, structural engineering and inspection approvals will add extra weeks to the schedule.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most room additions take three to six months to build, plus several weeks upfront for architectural design, structural engineering, and municipal permitting.
